repo_notes.content: tank-cq-level is a Raspberry Pi Zero W automation project that monitors a CQRobot optical water-level sensor and turns a pump on/off via a Digital Loggers smart PDU when an AC chiller condensation tank is full. Source is organized as versioned snapshots (0.0 through 0.5), not a single package layout. Prefer documenting 0.5/ as current; 0.0–0.4 are historical. In 0.5: cqr_env.py uses a frozen PduConfig dataclass (PDU) plus typed timing (POLL_INTERVAL_SEC, PUMP_ON_DURATION_SEC), GPIO_PIN, PDU_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SEC, and PDU_TLS_INSECURE; cqr_get.py edge-triggers pump ON (0→1) with re-arm after OFF, lazy setup_gpio(), absolute path to cqr_sec.py, and pdu_ok() checks before starting the timer; cqr_pdu.py PDUManager wraps curl/ssh with subprocess timeouts, optional -k via PDU_TLS_INSECURE, and pdu_ok(); cqr_sec.py turns the outlet OFF after countdown and raises on invalid protocol or failed OFF. Automated tests live under 0.5/tests/ (pytest). Deployment target is systemd service pdu-manager on Debian Bookworm with RPi.GPIO (WiringPi used for gpio readall during setup). Credential placeholders in cqr_env.PDU are site templates, not real secrets.
repo_notes.author: awuehler

pages.title: Project Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to tank-cq-level: purpose, hardware inventory, end-to-end automation loop (sensor → Pi → PDU → pump), and version history. Prefer 0.5/ as the current software reference.

pages.title: Hardware Inventory & System Architecture
pages.purpose: Describe physical components (Raspberry Pi Zero W, CQRobot optical sensor, ECO-WORTHY RV pump, Digital Loggers smart PDU), how they interconnect, and the feedback loop from sensor detection to pump activation.

pages.title: Version History & Evolution
pages.purpose: Trace development from 0.0 (C sample and Python port) through 0.1–0.4 (PoC, modular refactor, PDUManager, deploy cleanup) to 0.5 (PduConfig, edge-triggered control, timeouts, pdu_ok, pytest suite). Note droplet false-positive workaround (hydrophobic coating).

pages.title: Core Software Architecture (v0.5)
pages.purpose: Overview of the four-module Python layout in 0.5/: cqr_env, cqr_get, cqr_pdu, cqr_sec — responsibilities, edge-triggered pump cycles, single non-blocking timer child, and how modules interact. Link to child pages for each module and the test suite.

pages.title: Environment Configuration (cqr_env.py)
pages.purpose: Document 0.5 cqr_env.py: PduConfig/PDU fields (vendor, host, user, password, outlet, protocol), POLL_INTERVAL_SEC, PUMP_ON_DURATION_SEC, BOOL_OUTPUTS, GPIO_PIN, PDU_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SEC, PDU_TLS_INSECURE, and TIME_CHECKED back-compat aliases.

pages.title: Main Monitoring Loop (cqr_get.py)
pages.purpose: Document 0.5 cqr_get.py: setup_gpio() (hardware-free import), rising-edge / post-OFF re-arm logic, start_pump_cycle() with pdu_ok gate, absolute Path spawn of cqr_sec.py, verbose vs control path (BOOL_OUTPUTS), bootstrap OFF in __main__, and KeyboardInterrupt cleanup.

pages.title: PDU Control Layer (cqr_pdu.py)
pages.purpose: Document 0.5 PDUManager: run_curl timeouts, pdu_url HTTP/SSH construction using cqr_env.PDU, outlet argument vs default, Digest auth, CSRF headers, JSON auto-detect, pdu_ok(), and TLS insecure (-k) controlled by PDU_TLS_INSECURE.

pages.title: Pump Timer (cqr_sec.py)
pages.purpose: Document 0.5 cqr_sec.py: countdown logging, protocol validation (http/ssh), pdu_url FALSE with pdu_ok verification, raises on failure, and default_timer_count() from PUMP_ON_DURATION_SEC.

pages.title: Test Suite (0.5/tests)
pages.purpose: Document the pytest suite under 0.5/tests/: mocked GPIO/PDU fixtures in conftest.py, coverage for env dataclass, PDU timeouts/pdu_ok/TLS flag, edge-triggered get loop, timer OFF/failure paths, and how to run via requirements-dev.txt / pytest.ini.

pages.title: GPIO & Sensor Integration
pages.purpose: Overview of Raspberry Pi GPIO use for the CQRobot sensor (BCM pin from GPIO_PIN, default 18), historical 0.0 C/Python ports, droplet false positives, and hydrophobic coating workaround.

pages.title: Original C Implementation (cqrobot.c)
pages.purpose: Cover 0.0/ WiringPi C sample: wiringPiSetup, pinMode, digitalRead loop, binary liquid/no-liquid output, and role as reference for the Python port.

pages.title: Python GPIO Port (cqrobot.py)
pages.purpose: Cover 0.0/ RPi.GPIO port: BCM pin 18, polling loop, GPIO.cleanup(), and pin correction vs the C original.

pages.title: Deployment & Operations
pages.purpose: Guide for deploying 0.5/ on a Raspberry Pi as systemd service pdu-manager: copy tree, edit cqr_env.PDU and timing constants, enable unit, journalctl monitoring, SSH key setup for PDU access.

pages.title: systemd Service Setup
pages.purpose: Step-by-step pdu-manager.service install: copy 0.5 to /usr/local/src/cqr-pdu, unit file under /etc/systemd/system/, enable/start, verify with systemctl and journalctl.

pages.title: Runtime Configuration & Tuning
pages.purpose: How to tune 0.5 cqr_env.py for a site: PDU host/credentials/outlet/protocol, POLL_INTERVAL_SEC and PUMP_ON_DURATION_SEC, BOOL_OUTPUTS, PDU_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SEC, PDU_TLS_INSECURE, and Digital Loggers SSH public-key setup.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Define project terms and abbreviations (CQRobot, PDU, PduConfig, pdu_ok, edge-triggered ON, systemd pdu-manager, etc.) with pointers into 0.5 source where useful.
